statement.zh: Loud《霍尔萨巴德》I（OIP 38，1936）公布萨尔贡二世宫殿、宫殿神庙与城门区发掘，并含 Frankfort、Jacobsen 章节。
statement.en: Loud’s Khorsabad Part 1 (OIP 38, 1936) publishes excavations in Sargon II’s palace, palace temples, and a city gate, with chapters by Frankfort and Jacobsen.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only; density pass 3.
